customer_name.description: The full name of the customer.

customer_full_address.description: The complete shipping address for the delivery.

product_category.description: The internal category classification of the ordered product.

product_name.description: The name of the ordered product.

product_description.description: A detailed description of the product.

payment_mode.description: The payment method used for the order (e.g., cod, prepaid).

objective.description: The specific goal the voicebot must achieve on this call.

context_summary.description: A brief summary of the order or issue context for the voicebot.

domain_constraints.description: Specific behavioral constraints the voicebot must follow for this domain.

allowed_actions.description: The list of system actions the voicebot is authorized to take.

material.description: The material composition of the product.

return_exchange_condition.description: The policies governing return and exchange of this product.

actual_item_price.description: The actual price the customer paid for the item.

collectable_amount.description: The amount to be collected from the customer upon delivery.

order_date.description: The date the order was placed.

courier_partner.description: The logistics partner handling the delivery.

past_delivery_attempts.description: The number of times delivery has been attempted previously.

destination_pincode.description: The postal code for the delivery address.

prior_communication_summary.description: A summary of previous contact attempts and customer responses.

offered_reattempt_date_1.description: The first available date for scheduling a redelivery.

offered_reattempt_date_2.description: The second available date for scheduling a redelivery.

diagnostic_priority_instruction.description: An instruction directing the bot to diagnose reasons for past delivery failures.

mission_conversation_mission.description: The overarching conversational mission for the voicebot.

mission_why_this_call.description: The reason the bot is initiating contact with the customer.

mission_primary_objective.description: The main objective of the mission.

mission_success_condition.description: The condition that determines the mission's success.

mission_initial_state.description: The initial state of the conversation.

mission_allowed_next_states.description: The allowable state transitions in the conversation flow.

mission_conversation_priority.description: The priority level of this conversation mission.

mission_return_to_mission.description: Instruction on how to return to the mission if the conversation digresses.

brand_name.description: The name of the brand the bot is representing.

engagement_id.description: The unique identifier for the current customer engagement.

action_request_id.description: The unique identifier for the specific action request.

awb_no.description: The Air Waybill tracking number for the shipment.
